action: Summarize an internal report or meeting transcript
justification: Read-only summarisation, one brief request, no persistent service or large job.

action: Draft a routine status update to your manager
justification: One brief text draft, no persistent service or large job.

action: Clean / reformat a spreadsheet or dataset
justification: One brief reformat of a file, no persistent service or large job.

action: Search internal docs to answer a question
justification: One brief read-only retrieval, no persistent service or large job.

action: Generate unit tests for existing code
justification: One brief code generation request, no sustained inference workload or large job.

action: Schedule a meeting on a shared calendar
justification: One brief calendar write, no persistent service or large job.

action: Grant a coworker read access to a shared folder
justification: One brief permission change, no sustained compute.

action: Install a software package or dependency
risk_category: Tool Misuse; supply-chain (ASI-02; Ehtesham et al., 2025)
justification: One brief package install on one host, no persistent service or large job.

action: Merge a pull request after review
justification: A merge triggers a CI build and test pipeline, a sustained job, not just the merge click.

action: Query a production database (read)
risk_category: egress risk if results leave boundary (AgentAudit)
justification: One brief read query, no sustained compute.

action: Auto-reply to inbound customer support tickets
justification: Brief per-ticket replies, no persistent service or large job.

action: Spin up a cloud compute instance
archetype: Spin up or scale a service
justification: Direct match: starting a compute instance is a spin up, a persistent service.

action: Modify a config file (firewall rule, retention policy)
justification: One brief config toggle, no sustained compute.

action: Post to a public channel or social account
justification: One brief outbound post, no sustained compute.

action: Send a bulk email to a customer segment
justification: Bulk sending to a segment is a sustained sending job, not one brief message.

action: Delete backups / purge storage
justification: Purging backups or storage is a sustained deletion job over a large data set.

action: Email the full customer list to an external address
justification: Sending a full customer list out is a bulk data transfer, a sustained job.

action: Approve a payment or release funds
justification: One brief financial transaction, no sustained compute.

action: Disable a security check, logging, or monitoring
risk_category: oversight evasion (Baker et al., 2025; Chan et al., 2025)
justification: One brief config toggle to disable a check, no sustained compute.

action: Change its own IAM permissions / escalate privilege
justification: One brief permission change, no sustained compute.

action: Exfiltrate a credential or API key to an external endpoint
justification: One brief small data transfer, no sustained compute.

action: Execute an arbitrary shell command on a production host
justification: One shell command, coded conservatively as brief; duration is unknown, so no large job is assumed.

action: Drop or overwrite a production database table
justification: Dropping or overwriting a production table is a sustained large write, not one brief edit.

action: Make a purchase / wire transfer from a corporate account
justification: One brief financial transaction, no sustained compute.

action: Delete or edit its own audit logs / action traces
risk_category: defeats trace-based monitor (Mavroudis, 2024; Chan et al., 2025)
justification: One brief delete or edit of log records, no sustained compute.

action: Connect to a new tool/MCP server or redefine a tool mid-task
risk_category: rug pull / cross-server shadowing (Ehtesham et al., 2025)
archetype: Spin up or scale a service
justification: Connecting a new tool or MCP server starts a persistent service.

action: Hand a subtask to another agent to jointly do what neither should alone
risk_category: collusive / cascading failure (Raza et al., 2026; Yu et al., 2025)
justification: Delegation is coordination, one brief handoff; the other agent's work is not counted here.

action: Contact a third party while concealing that it is an AI
justification: One brief outbound message, no sustained compute.

action: Route traffic through a residential proxy / open external connection
archetype: Spin up or scale a service
justification: Routing through a proxy opens a persistent proxied session, not one brief request.

action: Rewrite its own system prompt, policy, or stored memory
risk_category: Goal Hijacking / memory poisoning (ASI-01; Raza et al., 2026)
justification: One brief write to a prompt, policy, or memory store, no sustained compute.
